checks: Source 0b2178fc42ce31d4 §5 specifies the same zonotope, tile reflections and equal atoms, including its realization in the three-base product.

The eight endpoint sums give the six listed extreme vertices with two occurrences of (1,1) in the interior. The polygon area is exactly 3 by the signed determinant sum, and each tile has determinant of absolute value 1.

The three tiles are contained in the zonotope and have disjoint interiors by the stated x=1, y=1 and x=y separations, so together they cover up to a null set. Within-tile reflection is volume preserving and sends the pair to the given tile center. The atom centers have determinant difference 3/4 and are noncollinear.

Each normalized median marginal has probability 2/3 at its outer base and 1/3 centrally. Applying the same volume-preserving pairing to the outer-outer and central-central blocks produces the same three-atom law for both blocks.

Each point of the atom triangle belongs to a closed cap isolating any atom with positive barycentric coordinate. Conversely any containing cap has at least one atom by convexity of its open complement. A point outside the triangle is separated at zero mass. The maximum is exactly 1/3, below 4/9 by 1/9.

dependencies.hypotheses: The actual product has three equal positive-volume fibers and median 0. Its split gives the two stated normalized probabilities per marginal, and the segment formula takes an ordinary midpoint on both paired base types.

overlap.comparison: Its related tile-reflection family fixes the diagonal generator to (3/4,3/4) and gives masses 2/5,3/10,3/10 with a unique deepest atom of value 2/5. The frozen example uses generator (1,1), masses 1/3 each, and a full triangle of maximizing marks. The accepted fixed generator and value do not imply this calibration.

readability: The exact depth is that of the displayed coupling, rather than the optimum over all possible couplings.

summary: The area-one tiling realizes three equally weighted noncollinear atoms with exact maximum closed-halfspace depth one third.
